capabilities: Build weekly plans and race taper
Track body measurements, pain and skills
disambiguation: Not a form builder; it is a training, recovery and nutrition log.
extras: In development (0.5.0); only part of the features has been tried in Obsidian, and fewer on phones. No food logging; not a medical app.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log workouts, track recovery and connect training load to daily readiness and nutrition advice.

relations.evidence: Runna on the Plan tab then loads the next 4 weeks into your week plan.
Since June 2026 Strava only lets accounts with a paid subscription create an API application.
From another log – strength workout history from Strong and Hevy exports (CSV).
Daily data from your watch or phone – steps, sleep duration, HRV, resting heart rate and weight from CSV, Apple Health

summary: Training log that turns workout and morning check-in notes into readiness, weekly plans and nutrition suggestions with cited sources.
